tweet.text: When we say that domestic mass surveillance and autonomous lethal weapons are red lines for us, we mean what we say, and are not looking for loopholes. We are confident that the combination of legal restrictions, safety stack, and deployment surfaces, will ensure that OpenAI models will not be used to cross either of these red lines.
